paper.title: Algorithm 819: AIZ, BIZ: Two Fortran 77 Routines for the Computation of Complex Airy Functions

stack: Fortran 77 (TOMS 819, shipped driver Fortran77/Dp/Drivers/driver.f, program WRTEST)

claim.text: Wronskian checks for scaled Airy functions (IFAC=2), the four maxima WRTEST prints in the shipped Drivers/res1..res4, each within 1e-13 absolute of the shipped value; the paper states relative accuracy better than 1e-13 (Section 4.1)

attempt: Reproduced. The authors' Fortran 77 sources compile as shipped with gfortran -O2 (Fortran77/Dp/Drivers/driver.f with Src/src.f and Src/port.f; no edits; original attempt compiled, compile_exit=0, and both runs exited 0). Two passes (the original binary in its build directory; the same binary in a clean directory) give identical res1..res4 maxima. Each |ours - shipped| is at most 1.1e-16, far inside the registered absolute tolerance 1e-13, and every maximum is strictly below 1e-13, the paper's stated bound. Note: the readme says port.f needs replacing on Fortran 77 compilers; gfortran accepts its Fortran 90 intrinsics as shipped, so no patch was needed.
